items.name: latex-toolkit
items.title: Latex Toolkit
items.description: Set up, build, and debug a LaTeX thesis: project layout with one file per chapter, latexmk builds, biblatex or natbib bibliography wiring, university template adoption, compile-error diagnosis from the .log (undefined control sequence, missing $, overfull boxes, undefined citations), cross-references, figures and tables, and the packages worth using. Use when starting a LaTeX thesis, when a build fails, when references show as question marks, or when adopting a department template.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
